import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    q = int(data[1])
    arr = [int(v) for v in data[2:2 + n]]
    pos = 2 + n
    out = []
    for _ in range(q):
        op = data[pos]
        x = int(data[pos + 1])
        y = int(data[pos + 2])
        pos += 3
        if op == '1':
            arr[x - 1] = y
        else:
            best = arr[x - 1]
            for k in range(x, y):
                if arr[k] < best:
                    best = arr[k]
            out.append(str(best))
    print('\n'.join(out))


main()

import sys

seed = int(sys.stdin.readline())

n = rng.randint(1, 12)
q = rng.randint(1, 12)
arr = [rng.randint(1, 20) for _ in range(n)]
lines = [f'{n} {q}', ' '.join(map(str, arr))]
for k in range(q):
    if k < q - 1 and rng.random() < 0.4:
        lines.append(f'1 {rng.randint(1, n)} {rng.randint(1, 20)}')
    else:
        l = rng.randint(1, n)
        r = rng.randint(l, n)
        lines.append(f'2 {l} {r}')
print('\n'.join(lines))
